label: TP
reason: Assessed both alerts. The java/xss alert is a False Positive (FP) because ESAPI.encodeForHTML sanitizes the file path string before HTML output, neutralizing script injection. The java/path-injection alert is a True Positive (TP) because the file path (fileTarget) is constructed from 'bar', which derives from user-supplied HTTP header names ('name') without sanitization or traversal prevention, enabling directory traversal risks.

evidence.note: XSS sink uses encodeForHTML to sanitize fileTarget.toString(), making this alert FP.
Path injection sink (fileTarget) is built from 'bar' (derived from user header name) without sanitization, driving TP verdict.
